posts.summary_en: Result screen 43,805,176,958 at 2G 168M total power, 1st on the server, 6.166 s left. Beam and ATK top six: Milk, Figure, Scorpion, then Melon Soda, Cream Puff, Vampire. posts.summary_en: Poster's model: when Cheesecake buffs, Milk's multi-stack ATK buff is replaced and restarts at one stack, and Lime does the same to Macaron's stacks; the beam goes Milk (fixed), then Figure, then Macaron. Proposal: Milk ATK #1 with Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion, Figure and Macaron ATK #2-3, every cookie that takes Pomegranate's or Milk's buff by priority pushed out of the top 40, Cheesecake, Lime and Orange out too, and some charging tanks out. Replies: getting Macaron to #3 means deep level-downs of dealers; whales with 10-star dealers drop them to Lv.50; the poster moved from 0.7G to 0.88G.
mechanics: Before 9/10, a new same-type buff replaced a stacked one and restarted its stacks.

posts.title_en: Long post: Crumble Dungeon 43G guide, controlling Milk's position
posts.summary_en: Recommended guide by 스미노프TFT (server in the 100s, #1 in power but #4 in the dungeon before a week of testing). Result 43,193,915,016 at 3G 505M, 1st, 4.366 s left, with two roster screenshots. Rules: the top 40 by power fight first and earn nearly all the score; Cheesecake and Lime overwrite Milk's and Macaron's higher buffs, so leave them out; arena gear preset without accuracy or focus, built on Skill Haste, crit damage, crit rate and Skill AMP; Milk captain with Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion at mercenary Lv.4 (Rapid Promotion alone at Lv.3); ATK order Milk > Scorpion > Figure > other dealers, set by lowering levels, with Milk and Figure in the top three; tanks gain nothing from the beam. Supports above Lv.70 made Milk crawl in from the back, so supports stay at Lv.70 or below except Macaron and Milk; Red Pepper and Dark Cherry charge in, get hit, and Milk runs to heal them, reaching the centre at about 53 s. Spend about 1,000 sugar-rune crafts on minor dealers for damage lines. Comments: an app-player trick moved Milk by holding the up key (patched later); cookies outside the 40 join when the 40 die, but at high power everyone is wiped with 8 s left.
mechanics: Top 40 by power deploy first; the rest enter as they die.
Supports above Lv.70 delay Milk's arrival.
A late-fight attack sweeps the team (about 15 s or 8 s left).

quotes.kr: 사실 전투력 상위40마리가 먼저 싸우고 얘네가 사실상 점수 다 벌어옴
quotes.en: In fact the top 40 by power fight first and earn practically all the score

posts.title_en: Why are the Crumble Dungeon rewards like this?
posts.summary_en: Screens of the reward tables. Today's ranking (paid by mail 12:00-13:00 KST): 1st 2,000 research stones, 200 one-minute speed-ups, 150 pet tickets; 2nd 1,500/150/90; 3rd 1,000/100/60; to 10th 800/80/30; to 50th 500/50; to 100th 400/40; to 200th 300/30; to 500th 200/20; to 1,000th 150/15; participation 100/10. Weekly ranking: 1st 100K coins, 100K XP, 20,000 crystals; 2nd 80,000/80,000/15,000; 3rd 70,000/70,000/10,000; to 10th 60,000/60,000/5,000; to 50th 50,000/50,000; to 100th 40,000/40,000; to 200th 30,000/30,000; to 500th 20,000/20,000; to 1,000th 15,000/15,000; participation 10,000/10,000. The poster got the ~200 bracket because the daily ranking pays yesterday's score.
mechanics: Daily ranking pays yesterday's best run; the lobby shows the weekly board.
